usageNotes: Use this to open an interactive terminal session on a PBS node accessed through a PDM-configured remote. The endpoint returns a short-lived VNC/WebSocket ticket and user identity — the caller must immediately upgrade the connection to a WebSocket using that ticket before it expires. Requires the Sys.Console privilege on the remote+node ACL path and is restricted to users (API tokens alone may not suffice depending on PDM configuration).

examples.summary: Open a terminal proxy session on node 'pbs01' of remote 'hetzner-pbs'

tips: The returned 'port' is always 0; it is not used for connection routing — the WebSocket upgrade itself carries the session.
The ticket is short-lived; initiate the WebSocket upgrade immediately after receiving it.
Node value 'localhost' is accepted and refers to the PDM-local PBS node when the remote is a loopback-style configuration.
API token access is allowed (allowtoken: true), but the Sys.Console privilege must be explicitly granted to the token's ACL path at /resource/{remote}/node/{node}.
